strategy.optimization_target: complete readable 50-panel chapter before polish alternates
strategy.first_draft_rule: Retain the 14 engineering-selected candidates as provisional layout assets and generate the 36 uncovered plans in contiguous story batches.
strategy.iteration_rule: After each batch, rebuild the full 50-slot scroll; repair only identity, causality, continuity, target-direction, or phone-readability failures before moving forward.
strategy.lettering_rule: Solve safe-field contrast with an outside-art band or carefully reviewed transparency before regenerating otherwise useful pixels.
strategy.acceptance_boundary: Owner approval authorizes continued work and best engineering judgment; it does not automatically accept, commercially clear, or promote any candidate as an exact production base.

SOREN.adult: clearly adult fictional man with mature proportions
SOREN.hair: short-to-medium wavy light-brown to dark-blond hair, swept back with loose damp strands; never black or bright blond
SOREN.face: weathered angular adult face with light beard or stubble
SOREN.wardrobe: pale oatmeal work coat over muted blue-gray work layers, dark trousers, practical wet-weather boots
SOREN.silhouette: lean sturdy working build; coat hem and folded map distinguish him at distance

SIGRID.adult: clearly adult fictional woman with mature proportions
SIGRID.hair: dark-brown to near-black hair in a low bun, knot, or compact braid; never blond
SIGRID.face: mature angular adult face, dark brows, alert gray-blue eyes
SIGRID.wardrobe: dark blue-brown practical plaid wrap over gray-green expedition layers, dark trousers, practical wet-weather boots
SIGRID.silhouette: athletic grounded working build; plaid wrap and dark tied-back hair distinguish her at distance

panels.beat: The pair leave the farmhouse before the damp grass dries.
panels.continuity_focus: downhill departure; dual adult wardrobe silhouettes

panels.beat: Sigrid checks the smoke direction against the folded map.
panels.continuity_focus: Sigrid face, dark tied hair, plaid wrap, folded map and smoke direction

panels.beat: Soren notices that the boot prints now overlap the trail rather than lead it.
panels.continuity_focus: crossing print chains and Soren's held-back boot

panels.beat: They exchange a look and continue without explaining the change.
panels.continuity_focus: match P002/P003 faces; opposite-thirds silent look

panels.beat: Rainwater feeds a shallow runnel across their path.
panels.continuity_focus: one readable water-flow vector; no people

panels.beat: Sigrid steps the runnel first and points out an older stone marker.
panels.continuity_focus: Sigrid leads; grounded weight shift and pointing hand; Soren waits

panels.beat: The marker bears a simple mill-wheel sketch, not a name.
panels.continuity_focus: carved circle unmistakable; no writing or people

panels.beat: Soren folds the map to hide the farmhouse and expose the creek line.
panels.continuity_focus: readable adult hands and map-fold geometry; no face required

panels.beat: The trail narrows under wet branches.
panels.continuity_focus: Sigrid leads, Soren follows; retain grounded mud and cloth motion

panels.beat: Sigrid hears the water before it is visible.
panels.continuity_focus: dark tied hair, plaid wrap, listening expression into open dark woods

panels.beat: Soren finds a length of soot-stained twine caught on a thorn.
panels.continuity_focus: twine-thorn contact, soot stain, readable adult hand

panels.beat: The twine points downhill as if pulled taut and released.
panels.continuity_focus: one diagonal force vector; empty trail; no people

panels.beat: They follow the creek instead of the tracks.
panels.continuity_focus: route change downhill; Sigrid leads; dual adult silhouettes

panels.beat: The smoke briefly disappears behind a shoulder of ridge.
panels.continuity_focus: smoke endpoint hidden by ridge; negative space; no people

panels.beat: Sigrid marks the loss of sight on the map with a wet thumb.
panels.continuity_focus: wet thumb obscures route line; plaid continuity

panels.beat: Soren says the smoke must be closer than it looks.
panels.continuity_focus: adults walking without facing; dialogue-capable profiles

panels.beat: The abandoned mill appears below, roofline broken against pale morning.
panels.continuity_focus: first mill reveal; broken roofline; creek geography; no people

panels.beat: Smoke rises from behind the mill rather than from its chimney.
panels.continuity_focus: telephoto spatial contradiction; smoke source behind mill

panels.beat: Sigrid signals Soren to stay off the open bridge.
panels.continuity_focus: Sigrid warning palm, Soren checked step, unsafe bridge

panels.beat: They cross the creek on stones below the bridge.
panels.continuity_focus: separated stepping rhythm and weight; bridge remains above

panels.beat: A freshly tied strip of red cloth moves from a lower branch.
panels.continuity_focus: fresh red cloth and one wind vector; background unreadable; no people

panels.beat: Soren stops Sigrid from touching the cloth.
panels.continuity_focus: hands nearly meet but neither touches red marker

panels.beat: They circle toward the mill's collapsed loading door.
panels.continuity_focus: side travel through grass and stable mill/bridge geography

panels.beat: A thin smoke thread rises from a metal drum hidden behind stone.
panels.continuity_focus: hidden drum location and thin smoke; no people

panels.beat: The drum contains only wet pine needles and a damp ember.
panels.continuity_focus: overhead evidence arrangement; wet needles and one damp ember

panels.beat: Sigrid tests the heat without disturbing the ember.
panels.continuity_focus: hand above ember, smoke between fingers, no contact

panels.beat: Soren sees a second twine line disappearing through the mill wall.
panels.continuity_focus: Soren eyeline and twine continue into wall darkness

panels.beat: The line is tied to a small brass bell inside the doorway.
panels.continuity_focus: exact line-to-brass-bell connection; bell still

panels.beat: Sigrid chooses the wall opening rather than the doorway.
panels.continuity_focus: Sigrid enters wall opening; Soren watches smoke/exterior

panels.beat: Inside, daylight bars stripe standing water and broken gears.
panels.continuity_focus: standing water, broken gears, barred daylight; no people

panels.beat: Sigrid finds dry footprints ending at the water's edge.
panels.continuity_focus: Sigrid crouched silhouette and dry-to-wet footprint boundary

panels.beat: Soren sees the footprints begin again on the far side, facing back.
panels.continuity_focus: deep perspective across water and reversed toe direction

panels.beat: A quiet drip rings the brass bell once from outside.
panels.continuity_focus: both adults freeze at different depths; one drip/bell event

panels.beat: Neither moves toward the bell.
panels.continuity_focus: empty doorway dominates; held adult silhouettes; no movement

panels.beat: Sigrid notices a sealed tin on an upper beam.
panels.continuity_focus: tin position must support P036 one-plank reach

panels.beat: Soren reaches it with a fallen plank while Sigrid braces the plank.
panels.continuity_focus: one continuous plank links Sigrid brace, Soren control, and elevated tin

panels.beat: The tin holds dry matches, a hand-drawn creek map, and a blank note card.
panels.continuity_focus: exact three contents readable; note card blank; no accidental writing

panels.beat: The map marks the farmhouse with a small square and the mill with a circle.
panels.continuity_focus: exactly square farmhouse and circle mill symbols with coherent route geography

panels.beat: A third mark is visible upstream, beyond the map edge.
panels.continuity_focus: Soren finger stops at torn edge; third mark distinct and upstream

panels.beat: Sigrid decides the smoke was a signal, not a campfire.
panels.continuity_focus: stable Sigrid face/hair/plaid and calm deduction

panels.beat: The hidden drum finally goes out in the rain.
panels.continuity_focus: thinning smoke and wet metal; no people

panels.beat: The bell rings again, now from the creek side.
panels.continuity_focus: empty doorway and one taut line establish changed source

panels.beat: They leave the tin open on the stone and retreat together.
panels.continuity_focus: cautious backward weight shift; open tin remains on stone

panels.beat: At the creek, Soren cuts the twine line with a pocket knife.
panels.continuity_focus: readable adult hands, pocket-knife edge, taut line, explicit cut point

panels.beat: The distant bell does not ring after the cut.
panels.continuity_focus: still creek and mill exterior; no bell motion; no people

panels.beat: Sigrid keeps the creek map inside her wrap rather than the notebook.
panels.continuity_focus: map transfers inside plaid wrap; notebook remains unused

panels.beat: They climb back toward the farmhouse under a cleared sky.
panels.continuity_focus: uphill vector reverses departure; clear sky; no smoke visible

panels.beat: From the ridge, the farmhouse is visible but its chimney has begun to smoke.
panels.continuity_focus: farmhouse and new chimney smoke legible at 390 px; no people

panels.beat: Soren realizes they did not light the stove before leaving.
panels.continuity_focus: oatmeal-coat Soren, folded map, alert turn, same distant house

panels.beat: Sigrid breaks into a run toward the house; Soren follows with the map.
panels.continuity_focus: Sigrid leads uphill; Soren follows with map; house ahead; mud and cloth motion
